Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. The second half of the effect still occurs even if you don’t have a security card to trash.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card if I have 0 cards left in my security stack?

Effect: [Main] Trash the top card of your security stack. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -5000 DP for the turn.
Security Effect: [Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.
